args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` was documented as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but was actually using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This changes the implementation to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and the requirements in FIN-212, and fixing the failing nightly test in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (including `tests/test_money.py`).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin212
